from_place: Tonawanda Creek Road (Pendleton, near Amherst line)
source_title: New Segment of Erie Canalway Trail Opens in WNY, Creating 135-Mile Uninterrupted Stretch
evidence: Canal Corp opened 2.1-mile section; Lt. Gov. Hochul ribbon cutting; creates 135-mile uninterrupted Buffalo-Finger Lakes stretch.
notes: Release dated 2019-09-27. A local trail group had earlier announced an Aug 19 opening; 2018 release projected summer 2019. Construction began May 2018.

source_title: New Section of the Erie Canalway Trail Between Lockport and Pendleton Officially Opens
evidence: Official ribbon-cutting opening marks completion of $5.4M project building four miles of 10-ft asphalt trail.
notes: CONFLICT: 2019 Canal Corp release says this section was completed in 2017; a 2018 release says late 2015; PTNY June 2016 says 5.5 mi; Niagara Gazette says 4.2 mi from State Road. Use ribbon-cutting date; construction may have finished late 2015.

source_title: Amsterdam-Pattersonville bike trail opens (Daily Gazette)
evidence: New 5-mile off-road section on former rail bed opened Wednesday; removes need to ride Route 5S shoulder.
notes: $1.75M State Parks project; ~4 mi in Town of Florida, ~1 mi in Rotterdam; new Pattersonville trailhead. Also PTNY and parks.ny.gov release r=1460 same date; a SportsDestinations repost is dated 2018-12-27.

source_title: Empire State Trail closes Rotterdam Junction gap (Daily Gazette)
evidence: $8M state project: new tunnel under PanAm tracks, rehabbed tunnel under CSX, three miles new trail; construction wrapped up previous month.
notes: Article dated 2021-01-02 says work finished the prior month (Dec 2020); no specific opening day. Coincides with statewide EST completion 2020-12-31.

segment_name: Rotterdam Junction paving (Mabie Lane to Leggiero Lane)
source_title: Project Completes Upgrades on 21-Mile Trail from Niskayuna to Rotterdam Junction
evidence: County paving of 1.65 miles completed upgrades to entire 21-mile Schenectady County portion of trail.
notes: $190,000 project; funding approved ~June 2022 with paving planned summer 2022 (Metroplex 2022-06-23; Daily Gazette 2022-06-26). Exact completion date not found.

from_place: Fort Herkimer Church / German Flatts Town Park (Route 55)
source_title: Canal Corporation Opens New Section of Erie Canalway Trail in Mohawk Valley
evidence: Canal Corp opened new $5.4M section from Fort Herkimer Church to Lock E-18, filling a trail gap.
notes: Release dated 2019-09-17; mileage not stated in search results. Construction began May 2018.

source_title: Governor announces completion of new Empire State Trail section in Herkimer County (parks.ny.gov r=1615)
evidence: State announced completed 2.4-mile section Lock E-18 to Route 167, giving continuous off-road path Fort Herkimer Church to Little Falls.
notes: CONFLICT on length: 2.4 mi (Nov 2020 release) vs 2.2 mi (2019 notice and final tally). One summary cited Nov 21, 2020; release itself dated Nov 20. $3.3M (CNYBJ) vs $2.1M (2019 release). Tioga Construction.

source_title: Canal Corporation Announces Opening of Three Empire State Trail Segments in the Mohawk Valley
evidence: Release dated 12/31/20 announces opening of 3.8-mile trail from Harbor Lock Road, Utica to Dyke Road, Schuyler.
notes: Length varies: 3.7 mi (2019 Canal Board), 3.5 mi (statewide completion release), 3.8 mi (opening release). Cost $8.3M (2019) vs $9.3M (completion release).

source_title: Canal Corporation Announces Opening of Three Empire State Trail Segments in the Mohawk Valley
evidence: Release dated 12/31/20 announces opening of 1.25-mile trail from Acme Road, Frankfort to Ilion Marina.
notes: Length 1.2 mi (2019 Canal Board), 1.3 mi (statewide tally), 1.25 mi (opening release).

surface: asphalt (10 ft); 130-ft bridge over Fulmer Creek
source_title: Canal Corporation Announces Opening of Three Empire State Trail Segments in the Mohawk Valley
evidence: Release dated 12/31/20 announces opening of 2-mile trail from Ilion Marina to East Main Street, Mohawk.
notes: Planned as 1.9 mi (governor's 2019 release, Carver Construction). Surface/bridge from 2019 announcement.

segment_name: Little Falls to Herkimer Home rehabilitation
source_title: Governor Hochul Announces Empire State Trail Improvements in Little Falls, Herkimer County
evidence: $1.2M rehab of ~20-year-old 2.5-mile trail; work to start Sept 27, 2021, finish by Memorial Day 2022.
notes: Announcement 2021-09-24; completion date not directly confirmed. PTNY Greenway Trails Progress Report (Aug 2021-Dec 2022) lists it completed. Release implies original trail built ~2001.

source_title: New trail segment gets Empire State Trail closer to completion (Canalway Trail Times)
evidence: State announced completion of 3.5-mile section built by Honeywell, now open, Camillus to Onondaga Lake area.
notes: Day from Camillus councilor post (camillusward2.com/?p=3847) and Canalway Trail Times; 2019 progress report had targeted spring 2020. Built under Onondaga Lake NRD settlement.

segment_name: West Shore extension (Visitors Center to Hiawatha Blvd)
source_title: Next phase of Onondaga County's Loop the Lake Trail complete (WRVO)
evidence: County's 1.1-mile extension crossing Harbor Brook to Hiawatha Blvd completed; opened Aug 14, 2020.
notes: Opening day from CNY Health article (cnyhealth.com/?p=4596); WRVO dated 2020-08-13. Unclear whether CSX bridge portion opened at same time; see separate bridge row.

source_title: 750-mile Empire State Trail completed with iconic bridge in CNY (WRVO)
evidence: $11M bridge over CSX tracks on south shore of Onondaga Lake described as now open.
notes: Reported open by 2021-01-04; Barton & Loguidice says Segment 3 finished end of 2020; Aug 2020 WRVO said county hoped to finish by year end. Exact day unknown; ~1,000 ft x 12 ft.

segment_name: I-481 bike/ped bridge and Towpath Road trail
source_title: Town of DeWitt - Elevating Erie (completed projects)
evidence: Town says new pedestrian bridge across I-481 was completed and opened in August 2020.
notes: Governor's 'major milestone' release (votesmart 1463277, ~Aug 2020) reports major construction finished on bridge and new trail along entire Towpath Road linking DeWitt trail to Bridge Street.

source_title: Governor announces completion of Empire State Trail (parks.ny.gov r=1620)
evidence: Completed-projects list includes 3-mile trail in Erie Blvd median, East Syracuse to DeWitt, $23M.
notes: No segment-specific opening date found; date is statewide completion/full opening (announced 12/30, open 12/31/2020). Cost $23M vs $27M in 2019 announcement.

notes: $1.75M; two sub-segments opened same day; media advisory 2015-07-02 set 2pm ceremony at Canal & Luquer Sts.

evidence: Seven miles of trail constructed in 2013, including one mile in the City of Little Falls.
notes: Exact location/endpoints not given in search results; other 6 miles built in 2013 not identified.

evidence: Two new stone dust sections finished in Town of Galen connecting Lock Berlin Park, Black Brook Park and Old Route 31.
notes: Reported May 2016 as finished; could have been completed in 2015. Same report: Lyons-Clyde gap reduced to 4.5 mi.

evidence: In 1973 three towpath segments were converted to recreational trail, including Lockport to Rochester.

evidence: First four-mile section of the trail opened in 1977.
notes: Location of first section not identified. Schenectady County says trail built late 1970s-early 1980s on towpath and former railbeds (Troy & Schenectady Branch); later sections undated.

segment_name: Mohawk Valley Gateway Overlook pedestrian bridge
source_title: Mohawk Valley Gateway Overlook (Wikipedia)
evidence: 511-ft pedestrian bridge over Mohawk River opened to public August 2016, ribbon-cutting August 31, 2016.
notes: Also WAMC and CBS6 coverage. Connector to the trail rather than mainline segment; include/exclude per research design. Cost $16.5M-$17.5M.

evidence: Towpath trail dedicated May 20, 2011 as Byron Lapp Memorial Trail leading into Montezuma Heritage Park.
notes: Dedication date from marker text; unclear whether this is part of the signed Erie Canalway/EST mainline or a local spur.

notes: Month from search summary only (also 13WHAM 'Improvements complete'); verify exact date.
